file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive Android architecture and development workflow guide
key_findings: 1028-line document capturing complete MASTER_PROMPT execution output
Includes 5-phase implementation plan with concrete deliverables
Defines architecture rules explicitly pinned for Claude Code compliance
Contains actionable templates for feature development and code review prompts
Documents specific risk mitigation strategies for each phase
Provides module dependency rules and performance budgets
file_insights.coverage: End-to-end architecture from POC validation through scaling

patterns_discovered.context: Module structure organized by feature (home, profile, workout) with shared core layers
patterns_discovered.benefit: Prevents feature-to-feature coupling, enables parallel development

patterns_discovered.context: Human defines interfaces/contracts BEFORE Claude generates implementation
Each phase (0-4) has explicit goals, deliverables, risks, and checkpoints
patterns_discovered.benefit: Clear stopping points to verify quality before progression

patterns_discovered.pattern: AI-generated code workflow (SPEC → CONTRACTS → SCAFFOLD → INTEGRATION → QA)
patterns_discovered.benefit: Leverages AI for scaffolding while humans handle complex logic and verification

patterns_discovered.context: Explicit rules in ARCHITECTURE.md (dependency isolation, state management, DI patterns)
patterns_discovered.benefit: Guides Claude Code generation and enables automated validation

gotchas_discovered.impact: POC validation requires physical device, blocks early testing
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Use mock Health Connect or delegate to Phase 3

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Claude Code generates deprecated Compose APIs
gotchas_discovered.impact: Generated code compiles but violates best practices
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Pin API version in prompts, add detekt rules, code review

gotchas_discovered.impact: Feature modules leak dependencies on each other despite rules
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Validate with `./gradlew :app:dependencies`, automated checks in CI

gotchas_discovered.impact: AI-generated code lacks proper structure, misses error handling
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Make CONTRACTS step mandatory before Claude generation

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: AI-generated code compiles but has subtle bugs
gotchas_discovered.impact: Runtime failures not caught by compilation
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Mandatory Macrobenchmark + unit tests + device testing before merge

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: DI setup complexity grows with module count
gotchas_discovered.impact: Hilt configuration becomes verbose, hard to maintain
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Use convention plugins in buildSrc to standardize setup

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Background execution and WorkManager edge cases
gotchas_discovered.impact: Human must implement WorkManager logic (AI cannot generate reliably)
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicitly exclude from Claude generation, create manual templates

approach_outcome.deliverable: Comprehensive, battle-tested implementation guide for Android development with Claude Code
approach_outcome.scope: Complete phased plan from POC validation (Phase 0) through scaling (Phase 4)
key_achievements: Defined modular architecture with explicit dependency rules
Created templates for Claude Code prompts (scaffold, code review)
Identified 7 major gotchas with mitigation strategies
Documented performance budgets and testing strategies
Provided concrete module structure and DI setup patterns
approach_outcome.execution_quality: High — document includes specific file paths, code examples, and actionable checklists
